Canton of Zurich (Zürich)

Zürich Altstadt & Limmatquai, Lake Zurich cruises & Uetliberg, Kunsthaus Zürich & Landesmuseum, Winterthur museums & Rhine Falls gateway.

334 전체 도시·시군구

Canton of Bern (Bern / Berne)

Bern UNESCO Old Town & Zytglogge, Jungfraujoch, Eiger & Grindelwald, Lauterbrunnen Valley & Mürren, Interlaken, Lake Thun & Lake Brienz.

300 전체 도시·시군구

Canton of Vaud (Vaud)

Château de Chillon & Montreux Riviera, Lavaux UNESCO Vineyard Terraces, Lausanne Olympic Museum & Cathedral, Glacier 3000 & Villars-sur-Ollon.

Canton of Geneva (Genève)

Canton of Lucerne (Luzern)

Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke) & Old Town, Lake Lucerne paddle steamers, Mount Pilatus & Mount Rigi excursions, Swiss Museum of Transport (Verkehrshaus).
